title: Elf Bar Plus50 Strawberry Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Ice from the Elf Bar Plus50 refill pod range combines juicy, sun-ripened Strawberry flavour with a fresh burst of cool Menthol. The berry sweetness is bright and authentic, while the icy finish keeps the vape feeling clean and refreshing. Each Plus50 pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and can join two other pods in the Elf Bar Plus50 Pod Kit, with no mess or fuss. The integrated mesh coil delivers consistently smooth performance with discreet vapour, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Each pod is topped up via a prefilled 10ml refill pod, and together each pod and refill can deliver up to 5,500 puffs of flavour.
